description: Search humanitarian job listings on ReliefWeb by country, organization, job type, career category, theme, and experience level. Returns current open positions — expired postings are excluded by default. Use include_archived=true to search the full history of postings, which is far larger than the open set. Use text search for role titles and job descriptions, and job_type for the kind of engagement (consultancy, internship) — text search finds only some of those.

career_category.description: ReliefWeb career category. One of: Program/Project Management, Monitoring and Evaluation, Administration/Finance, Advocacy/Communications, Human Resources, Logistics/Procurement, Donor Relations/Grants Management, Information Management, Information and Communications Technology, Other, Medical/Clinical, Legal/Compliance. Also accepts the abbreviations ICT, M&E, HR, and a word found in only one category name (Logistics resolves to Logistics/Procurement). Separate several categories with commas to require all of them. Case, spacing, and punctuation are ignored; any other value is rejected with the valid list. Matches whole career-category tags.

country.description: One or more ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes in any case, separated by commas or spaces (e.g., SYR, or SYR,AFG). Filters to jobs tagged with every listed country. A country name or two-letter code is rejected; find the code with reliefweb_list_countries text. Blank is omitted.

experience.description: Experience level (e.g., 0-2 years, 3-4 years, 5-9 years). Filters on experience.name.

include_archived.description: Search expired postings alongside the open ones. Uses preset=analysis. Off by default — the open set is a small fraction of the archive, so turn this on for labour-market history rather than for a hiring snapshot.

job_type.description: Kind of engagement. One of: Job, Consultancy, Internship, Tender/RFPs/EOIs, Volunteer Opportunity. A word found in only one type name also resolves (Tender, Volunteer). Separate several types with commas to match any of them — a posting carries one type. Case, spacing, and punctuation are ignored; any other value is rejected with the valid list. Filters on type.name.

limit.description: Number of results to return (1–1000, default 10). Larger integers are clamped to 1000 with a notice when clamping is enabled; otherwise they are rejected. Each call counts against the 1,000-calls/day quota.

offset.description: Zero-based offset for pagination. Use with limit and the totalCount enrichment field to page through results.

sort.description: Sort order. Use date.created:desc for newest postings first (default), date.closing:asc to surface roles closing soonest, or score:desc for relevance.

source.description: Organization short name (e.g., UNHCR, OCHA, WFP). Filters on source.shortname.

text.description: Full-text search query. Matches against job title, body, and key metadata fields.

theme.description: Sector or cross-cutting theme. One of: Protection and Human Rights, Health, Food and Nutrition, Shelter and Non-Food Items, Water Sanitation Hygiene, Agriculture, Coordination, Education, Contributions, Recovery and Reconstruction, Peacekeeping and Peacebuilding, Logistics and Telecommunications, Disaster Management, Safety and Security, Climate Change and Environment, Gender, Camp Coordination and Camp Management, Mine Action, HIV/Aids, Humanitarian Financing. Also accepts the abbreviations WASH, CCCM, NFI, and a word found in only one theme name (Protection resolves to Protection and Human Rights). Separate several themes with commas to require all of them. Case, spacing, and punctuation are ignored; any other value is rejected with the valid list. Matches whole theme tags.

name: reliefweb_search_jobs

appliedFilters.description: The resolved filter set the query actually ran with, after normalization and defaults. Echoes back so the agent can confirm how its inputs were interpreted.

careerCategory.description: Career category names applied, in canonical ReliefWeb spelling and comma-separated when several (postings must carry every one).

country.description: Country codes as normalized: uppercased ISO3, comma-separated when several.

jobType.description: Job type names applied, in canonical ReliefWeb spelling and comma-separated when several (a posting of any of them matches).

preset.description: ReliefWeb preset the query used: latest (open postings only, default) or analysis when include_archived.

sort.description: Sort order the query used (resolved, including the default).

theme.description: Theme names applied, in canonical ReliefWeb spelling and comma-separated when several (postings must carry every one).

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `unknown_job_type`: A job_type value names no ReliefWeb job type. `unknown_career_category`: A career_category value names no single ReliefWeb career category — an unknown name, a word shared by several category names, or words from more than one. `unknown_theme`: A theme value names no single ReliefWeb theme — an unknown name, a word shared by several theme names, or words from more than one. `invalid_query`: ReliefWeb rejected the query — possible causes include malformed text or an unrecognized sort field. `upstream_error`: The ReliefWeb API was unreachable, timed out, or returned a server error. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

countryIso3s.description: Uppercase ISO3 codes of the countries tagged on this job — the form the country filters and reliefweb_get_country take.

urlAlias.description: Canonical ReliefWeb URL for this job listing.

notice.description: Discloses requested and applied limits when clamped. For empty pages, names the match count and last reachable offset when records matched; otherwise echoes filters and suggests how to broaden.

totalCount.description: Total jobs matching the query before pagination.

title: Search ReliefWeb Jobs
